data.name: Dungeons of Ironshade
data.detailed_description:
What is it about?

Dive into the dark depths of Dungeons of Ironshade, a gripping dungeon crawler that sends you on an rescue mission. You lead a party of four brave adventurers through the labyrinthine corridors of an ancient dungeon. Each character belongs to one of four unique classes: Warrior, Paladin, Rogue, or Mage.

Together, you must fight your way through more than thirteen dangerous levels filled with deadly enemies, treacherous traps, and mystical puzzles. The journey begins with the desperate search for a missing mage — but her rescue is only the first step into a far greater adventure. In the depths of Ironshade, an ancient and malevolent evil awaits, one that only the bravest can defeat.

What awaits you?

  • Party-based dungeon crawler gameplay with 4 characters

  • A skill tree for character specialization as well as talents

  • More than 13 extensive levels

  • Plenty of puzzles and real-time combat

  • Character creation

  • 4 classes and 4 races

  • Different difficulty levels

  • Dynamic music

  • Easy-to-use magic system (1-click)

  • Recruitable companions who can join your party

  • Extensive equipment that your characters can equip directly

  • 36 spells

  • More than 25 different monster types

  • Over 40 weapons and numerous additional equipment items

  • Mini-quests and hidden secrets

  • Import of custom character portraits

  • Potion crafting

  • Automap (can be disabled)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380 or equivalent (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible Soundcard
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading times

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable graphics card (Intel Iris / AMD Radeon / Apple M1 GPU)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1/M2 GPU or dedicated AMD Radeon graphics card
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
